coefficients.policy: Published full-law coefficients unchanged; no test fitting.

harmonicModel.reference_input: Matched solid anchor factors are physical model inputs; no perforated prospective response may be used to alter coefficients
harmonicModel.evaluation_rule: Evaluate unchanged on all ten registered layouts; compare with exponential6 using identical global harmonic targets, five mixtures, all layouts and registered 10% P95 ceiling
harmonicModel.role: Secondary static formulation frozen before prospective FE response generation. Original six-layout outcomes are exposed development diagnostics, not fresh evaluation.

roadReference.fuel_volume_basis: Kim and Wallington historical no-resizing FRV

sensitivityAudit.role: Post-evaluation decision sensitivity; no coefficient change or fresh independent policy validation
sensitivityAudit.formula: F_reference in [F_prediction/(1+epsilon), F_prediction/(1-epsilon)] if the declared pointwise relative-error bound holds
sensitivityAudit.interpretation: The registered 10% P95 accuracy tier is not a uniform error guarantee. These conditional intervals and observed decisions do not certify unseen geometries or physical capacity.

scope: Case-linked retained evidence and newly computed scenario arithmetic. No refitting, new FE solve, case-specific convergence certification, measured production inventory or steel experiment. Conditional sensitivity intervals are not calibrated uncertainty bounds.
